items.name: Lake Superior
items.fact: Largest freshwater lake by surface area in the world.

items.name: Lake Michigan
items.fact: The only Great Lake entirely within the United States.

items.name: Lake Huron
items.fact: Includes Georgian Bay; second-largest of the Great Lakes by area.

items.name: Lake Erie
items.fact: Shallowest of the Great Lakes and the warmest in summer.

items.name: Lake Ontario
items.fact: Smallest Great Lake by area; drains to the Atlantic via the St. Lawrence.
